items.title: Energy minister discusses bilateral cooperation with Austrian counterpart
items.source_excerpt: VIENNA — Saudi Minister of Energy and Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman met with Austria’s Federal Minister of Economy, Energy and Tourism Wolfgang Hattmannsdorfer in Vienna on Monday. The meeting was held on the sidelines of the 70th General Conference of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).During the meeting, the ministers discussed energy and industrial cooperation and ways to strengthen it. They also reviewed issues of mutual interest.

items.title: Saudi Crown Prince to pay visit to Egypt on Tuesday
